title: This section has no template anywhere in the theme
subtitle: Rendered by partials/sections/generic.html
description: It exists because `data/sections.json` lists an entry with `style: "generic"` and names which fields to show. No Go template and no LaTeX were written for it.
details: Adding a section of your own takes two files: an array of records in `data/<name>.json`, and one entry in `data/sections.json`. Everything else — a page of its own, a JSON Schema, an issue form, a bespoke renderer — is optional.

title: It appears in the generated CV too
subtitle: Rendered by prettyprintGeneric in autoCV.tex
description: The CV walks the same `data/sections.json` the website does, so a section added as data reaches the PDF without any LaTeX being written. Set `inCV: false` to leave one out.
